### Are You Excited to Share the Good News?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-december-20-2023.html
Passage: Luke 2:10-11
Points:
- Receiving life-changing good news naturally creates an urgent desire to tell others immediately.
- The angel announced glad tidings intended not for a small group, but for all people everywhere.
- People from every walk of life—rich, poor, educated, or simple—stand in need of the Savior.
- Believers are challenged to examine their own excitement and actively share the gospel with others.

### The Treasurers
Author: Catherine Claire Larson
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-april-10-2023.html
Passage: Luke 2:19
Points:
- Mary responded to the shepherds' visit and the miraculous events by quietly cherishing them in her heart.
- Her pondering reflects not only holding onto the divine circumstances, but deeply valuing Jesus Himself.
- Treasuring and delighting in loved ones provides the fertile soil needed for holistic growth.
- Cultivating this posture of wonder equips believers to perceive God's work and speak life into others.

### The Shepherds’ Invitation: Come and See
Author: Lynette Kittle
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/the-shepherds-invitation-come-and-see-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Luke 2:9-12
Points:
- Ordinary shepherds working in the night received an astonishing heavenly invitation to see the newborn King.
- Rather than remaining frozen in fear, they eagerly went to Bethlehem to witness what the Lord had revealed.
- Experiencing Christ firsthand naturally compelled the shepherds to tell everyone what they had seen and heard.
- Modern Christians are urged to overcome hesitation and boldly invite others to know Jesus.

### Will Graham Advent Devotional Week Two: Shepherds
Author: Will Graham
Site: Billy Graham Evangelistic Association
URL: https://billygraham.org/articles/will-graham-advent-devotional-week-two-shepherds
Passage: Luke 2:8-18
Points:
- Working shepherds had their dark, routine shift interrupted by the blinding supernatural glory of God.
- The angel announced good tidings of great joy that the promised Messiah had arrived to rescue mankind.
- The shepherds moved through a whole spectrum of emotions, turning from fear into awe and joyful praise.
- Believers today are encouraged to reflect on Christ's arrival and rekindle the passion of their salvation.
